name: [🔥RELEASE + MOBILE] KEN
desc:
⚠️IMPORTANT! THIS GAME IS STILL IN HEAVY DEVELOPMENT, MORE CONTENT SOON⚠️

Take everything you've built into the streets. Rob, grip, raid, and climb the ranks solo or with your organization behind you. Every corner of the city has something strange going on, bosses lurking, tournaments, and other opponents to dethrone.

🥊 Train at gyms to build strength and learn powerful fighting styles!
👊 Defeat rival gangs, tough enemies, and powerful bosses!
🔥 Master new skills, upgrade your abilities, and rise to the top with friends!

🎮CONTROLS:
M1 - Basic Attack
M2 - Critical Attack
Q - Dash
W + W - Run
F - Block (Press M2 while blocking to perform a counter)
B - Grip
C - Rob
V - Carry
